cohort_sensitivity.interpretation: Original 120 and additional 360 are disjoint fixed prompt subsets collected in different batches. Differences can reflect prompt composition or service drift and are not a causal collection-time effect. The combined estimate weights every domain/level equally and every retained prompt equally within its cell.
